newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Hicom Islamic notes rated P2.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Hicom Islamic notes rated P2.

text.p: The Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd (RAM) said on Monday it has assigned a short-term rating of P2 for automobile and investment holding group Hicom Bhd's 500 million ringgit Murabahah Notes Issuance Facility.
RAM said in a statement that it has also reaffirmed the A2 rating for Hicom's 950 million ringgit of five-year redeemable secured bonds, which were issued last year.
It said the ratings were based on Hicom's strong financial flexibility.
"Hicom is an investment holding company of a large conglomerate that has a strong market presence in the automotive and heavy industries sector of Malaysia," RAM said.
However, in expanding its market presence, the group's gearing level has increased substantially over the past year, RAM said.
